Khushi ek sakaratmak drishtikon hai.
Happiness ek endless winding road hai.
Khushi shanti ka saar hai.
Khushi sab kuch hai.
Khushi phoolna hai.
Azaadi ki chah sabse taqatwar manav instinct hai.
Khushi achhi sehat aur kharab yaadash hai.
Khushi ek adhyatmik masal hai.
Azadi param kripa hai.
Khushi purani hai.
Aazadi ka koi fayda nahi agar usme galti karne ki aazadi na ho.
Azaadi avsar ka khula darwaza hai.
Khushi acche kismat ki baat nahi hai.
Joy ek pavitra aag hai jo hamare andar jalti hai.
Khushi ek sooraj ki kiran hai jo hazaron rangon se guzar sakti hai.
Khushi rooh ki hasi hai.
Joy himmat ka badge hai.
Sachhi khushi hum par zyada nirbhar karti hai.
Anand ka peecha nahi kiya ja sakta, woh khud aa jata hai.
Azaad log yeh yaad rakhein: hum azaadi paa sakte hain, par ek baar khone ke baad wapas nahi milti.
Khushi jeene ka aanand hai.
Bina kisi purpose ke wander karo, apni rooh dhoondo.
Khushi rachna hai.
Deadlines nahi, horizons chase karo; joy off the grid milta hai.
Ek aazad samaj woh hai jahan unpopular hona bhi safe ho.
Aazadi insaani kshamta ka kendra hai.
